children: Donald Michael Westermann, an officer serving as Chief Information Officer, reported sales of common stock on September 1, 2026. The transactions comprised 10,407 shares sold directly at $21.77 and 23,005 shares sold indirectly at $21.43, for a weighted average price of approximately $21.53 per share. The total sale amount reported was $719,557. Following the reported transactions, Westermann directly owns 22,565 shares and indirectly owns 4,990 shares (including shares held by a 401(k) and ESOP).
